+title: 'MTP: FoundationModels — run MLXLanguageModel text, reasoning and tool turns with the MTP drafter'
+---
+## What
+No FoundationModels path can use MTP today. `Executor.respond` → `runRespond` (Libraries/MLXFoundationModels/MLXLanguageModel.swift ~958-1168) goes to `runTextGeneration` / `runUnconstrained` / `runReasoning` / `runToolGeneration`, and these call `generateTaskRecordingTokens`, `generateProtocolTokensTask`, and `generateTokensTask` (Libraries/MLXLMCommon/Evaluate.swift ~2500, ~2797, ~2835). Each makes a plain `TokenIterator`. `ModelCache` (Libraries/MLXFoundationModels/ModelCache.swift ~46-139) holds one `ModelContainer` for each model ID and has no drafter slot. The default FoundationModels sampling is random (temperature 0.6, Evaluate.swift ~256), so this task needs the sampling task.
+
+This task covers generation and loading. The prompt-cache entry, checkpoint and spill work is a separate task.
+
+- [ ] Add an MTP option to `MLXLanguageModel` (for example `speculativeDecoding: MLXSpeculativeDecoding?` with a drafter model ID and `blockSize`), and a `ModelCache` drafter slot keyed by (model ID, drafter ID). Load the drafter through `MTPDrafterModelFactory` (Libraries/MLXLMCommon/MTPDrafterModelFactory.swift) with the MLXLLM and MLXVLM Qwen35 MTP registrations, one time, coalesced like model loads. `remove` / `evictAll` of a model also evicts its drafter.
+- [ ] Add an iterator choice to `generateTaskRecordingTokens`, `generateProtocolTokensTask`, and `generateTokensTask`: when a drafter is present and `isCompatible(with:)` is true, build `MTPSpeculativeTokenIterator` with the `state:` input; otherwise `TokenIterator`. Pass the drafter state in and return the final drafter state to the caller.
+- [ ] Run the drafter inside the existing `container.perform` of the target (MLXLanguageModel.swift ~1077). Do not nest a second `perform` on the `MTPDrafterContainer` (MTPDrafterModel.swift ~238-259); take the drafter model out of its container one time, so that no lock order can deadlock.
+- [ ] Cancellation: `generateLoopTask` checks cancellation before each `next()` (Evaluate.swift ~3015), and one MTP `next()` can run a full round. Make sure the drain in MLXLanguageModel.swift (~1870, "one forward pass") still holds, or update its comment and test.
+- [ ] Guided paths (`runSchemaGeneration`, `runRequiredToolTurn`) keep `GuidedGenerationLoop` in this task. Usage counts come from the final `.info` and stay correct (`tokenCount` increments for each returned token).
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A `LanguageModelSession` on the scripted Qwen35 + MTP fixture with `.greedy` gives the same text as without MTP, for plain text, reasoning, and allowed-tools turns.
+- [ ] With the default sampling mode and a fixed seed, an MTP session runs MTP (no passthrough) and its token distribution test from the sampling task passes through this path.
+- [ ] The drafter loads one time across two sessions of the same model, and evicting the model frees the drafter.
+- [ ] Reported usage (prompt and generated token counts) is the same with and without MTP for the same greedy text.
+- [ ] Real model: a FoundationModels greedy session with Qwen3.8-27B-4bit + MTP gives the same text as without MTP, and its decode tok/s is higher on the math prompt.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Tests/MLXFoundationModelsTests/MTPExecutorTests.swift: scripted-model tests for the three paths, the load count, eviction, and usage.
+- [ ] IntegrationTesting/IntegrationTestingTests/MLXFoundationModelsIntegration/TextGeneration/MTPGenerationTests.swift: the real-model equality and tok/s test; it skips when `mlx-community/Qwen3.8-27B-MTP-4bit` is not local.
+- [ ] `swift build --build-tests && xcrun xctest .build/out/Products/Debug/MLXLMTests.xctest` and the MLXFoundationModelsTests target pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #mtp #qwen38 #foundation-models
\ No newline at end of file
